item.title: Unlocking Advanced Log Analytics With ClickHouse® and Kafka
item.description: In the landscape of observability, logs reign as a fundamental pillar. Undoubtedly, they are among the most extensively employed telemetry signals. However, beneath their widespread usage by developers lies a complexity that cannot be ignored - logs are verbose, lack structure, and are hard to search and analyze. The pursuit of advanced analytics on this foundation can lead down a costly and intricate path. While tools like OpenSearch offer analytic features, their cost and operational complexity can be prohibitive.
